package service

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for service_imports_gin_directly: Service packages that depend on `github.com/gin-gonic/gin` instead of transport-neutral inputs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type ProfileService struct {
	repo ProfileRepository
}

func NewProfileService(repo ProfileRepository) *ProfileService {
	return &ProfileService{repo: repo}
}

func (s *ProfileService) GetProfile(c *gin.Context) (Profile, error) {
	id := c.Param("id")
	if id == "" {
		return Profile{}, fmt.Errorf("missing profile id")
	}
	return s.repo.FindByID(context.Background(), id)
}

type Profile struct {
	ID   string
	Name string
}

type ProfileRepository interface {
	FindByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (Profile, error)
}
